content:
Just weeks after announcing a price hike for Apple Music subscriptions, Apple today announced another price increase for Apple TV. The company confirmed to 9to5Mac that the Apple TV monthly fee will increase from US$12.99 to US$14.99.

The Individual plan of Apple One has also increased in price.

Apple TV and Apple One both increase in price

Below are the complete details of the price hikes:

  • Apple TV (monthly): US$14.99 (originally US$12.99)
  • Apple TV (annual): US$119 (originally US$99)
  • Apple One Individual: US$21.95 (originally US$19.95)

Prices for other Apple One plans remain unchanged. Last month, when Apple raised the price of Apple Music, it also raised prices for Apple One Family and Apple One Premier, but did not raise the price of the Individual plan.

New subscribers will be charged at the new rate starting today; existing subscribers will receive a notification from Apple about a month in advance regarding the price adjustment arrangements.

The last time Apple raised the price of Apple TV was in August 2025, when the monthly fee went from US$9.99 to US$12.99, during which the prices of annual plans and Apple One bundle plans remained unchanged.

Over the past year, Apple has significantly expanded the content lineup of Apple TV. Last October, the company announced a deal with F1, becoming the exclusive broadcast partner for F1 in the United States. The F1 streaming service is included in the standard Apple TV subscription at no extra charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added Major League Soccer (MLS) streaming to Apple TV at no extra charge. Previously, MLS matches required a separate MLS Season Pass subscription to watch.

Apple has also capitalized on the momentum of several successful show launches in recent months, including the fourth season of Ted Lasso. Apple TV also premiered the second season of Dark Matter today. The sixth season of Slow Horses will premiere on September 16.

What do you think of the new Apple TV pricing? At US$14.99, is it reasonable for the content Apple TV offers? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
